idea-plugin.name: SS14 Prototype Editor
idea-plugin.description:
Autocomplete, hover docs and go-to-definition for Space Station 14 YAML prototypes, built from any SS14 fork's code.

  • Component names after - type:, including the ones only your fork has.
  • Fields of components, nested data definitions and prototypes; fields already written are not offered again.
  • Values: booleans, enum and flag values, prototype types, the classes allowed after a !type: tag.
  • Prototype ids in parent: and in any field that references a prototype, filtered to the right kind.
  • Resource paths under Resources/ in fields that take one.
  • Hover over a component, a field or a !type: tag for its C# docs, type and default.
  • Go to definition from a prototype id to its declaration, from a component or tag to its C# class.

Getting started. Build your fork once (dotnet build), open its solution in Rider and open any file under Resources/Prototypes/. The plugin needs the .NET SDK and Node.js 18+; if Node.js is missing, it offers to download it. It never writes into the fork folder.

The same engine as the SS14 Prototype Editor for VS Code. Icon: Space Station 14 logo by AftrLite, CC-BY-SA-4.0.
